fato_historico: 1942: World War II: Ocean Liner RMS Queen Mary accidentally rams and sinks HMS Curacoa, killing over 300 crewmen aboard Curacoa.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a reflective current, reminding us that even the mightiest vessels must navigate currents with care. Consider your own path, Sagittarius; like a vast ocean, your spirit is wide, but mindful choices ensure safe passage. It is a good time to steer your energy toward healing connections and letting go of heavy burdens that no longer serve your voyage.
frase_do_dia: Even in deep waters, the light of your spirit guides you safely home.
significado_numero: Represents the strength found in overcoming challenges and navigating new emotional tides.
conselho: Move through your day with gentle awareness and prioritize harmony in your interactions.
